records.title: Wayanad Tunnel Road Project
details:
1. So, today, Palakkad-Kozhikode is one of the important projects. We already have the project proposal that is to be submitted to the Ministry. We are now working on it. We will make the pre-feasibility report. Positively, we will try to resolve that issue. That is the need of that particular region.
2. Sir, I would like to bring the attention of the hon. Minister to the deplorable state of NH-12, which goes through Kolkata. It used to be NH-34. It is now NH-12, which is basically the North Bengal and South Bengal. The condition of the road from Barajaguli to the Murshidabad border, going to the district of Nadia, after the monsoon is absolutely abysmal.
महाराष्ट्र में मुम्बई-गोवा हाईवे का काम चलते हुए 10 साल से भी ज्यादा का समय हो गया है। 
अभी लगभग 89 प्रतिशत तक काम पूरा हो चुका है और इस वर्ष अप्रैल तक यह रोड पूरा हो जाएगा। इसमें कोई तकलीफ नहीं होगी। इसमें काफी विलम्ब हुआ है, मैं इस बात को स्वीकार करता हूं। यह अप्रैल से पहले पूरा हो जाएगा।
